infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AntarTalk needs camera access only when you join a video session or choose a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AntarTalk needs microphone access only when you join a video session.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AntarTalk needs photo library access when you choose a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: AntarTalk uses notifications for appointment and booking updates.
